summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper, enum, and tests. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) with eleven members, each commented. botocore/args.py makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None, imports the enum as EPRBuiltins, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Results: test_args.py and test_regions.py pass (163 tests). The full tests/unit run has 11 failures (test_awsrequest, test_session, test_session_legacy), and the same 11 fail on the original code, so they are pre-existing. Notes: FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private lookups (_resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint) because no public ones exist. black and isort could not be run because the venv lacks them; line lengths were checked by hand. Nothing is committed.
